description: This file defines the VecMask class and related template structures for handling vectorized masks in SIMD operations within the at::vec namespace. It provides methods for creating, converting, and manipulating mask vectors used in CPU vectorization.

classes.name: VecMask
classes.description: A class representing a vectorized mask used in SIMD operations, with methods for creation, conversion, masking checks, and loading data.

classes.name: VecMaskLoad
classes.description: A helper template struct for loading data from memory using a mask.

classes.name: VecMaskTo
classes.description: A helper template struct for converting a mask to boolean or other types.

classes.name: VecMaskCast
classes.description: A helper template struct for casting masks between different base types.

classes.name: VecMaskCheck
classes.description: A helper template struct for checking if all mask elements are zero, all masked, or a specific element is masked.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method in VecMaskLoad, VecMaskTo, and VecMaskCast for applying specific load, cast, or conversion operations.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method in VecMask for creating a VecMask from various input types.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Method in VecMask for casting the mask to a different type.

methods.name: all_zero
methods.description: Checks if all elements in the mask are zero.

methods.name: all_masked
methods.description: Checks if all elements in the mask are masked.

methods.name: is_masked
methods.description: Checks if a specific element is masked.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the mask elements into a boolean array.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Converts the mask to another vectorized type.
